name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Write a Q# operation that prepares an 6-qubit
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Write a Q# operation that prepares an 6-qubit GHZ state using ApplyToEach and returns the measurement results as an array, with a Python driver printing the distribution over 1000 shots. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
